title: 4th Unique Awards — Fourth Batch of Jury Guests Announced
summary: Same 4th Unique Awards call context: ~200 cases; go-global 41.3%; awards early Dec; 100-person multi-committee jury.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Insight / Awards · November 22, 2022

Same 4th Unique Awards call context: ~200 cases; go-global 41.3%; awards early Dec; 100-person multi-committee jury.

This fourth guest batch: Lai Chunlin — Shengtian Network chair/GM (ChiNext listed Hubei internet pioneer); Liu Jinyao (Steve) — Activation Group / Eddid Weixuan founder & co-chair/CEO (ex-Dell Asia brand director, ¥120B+ book); Luo Weidong — Aurora (Nasdaq:JG) founder/CEO; Wu Guangyu — Dun & Bradstreet China president; Jennifer Zhang — impact.com Greater China president (ex-Zanox APAC MD / Dell / Ogilvy); Chen Chuanqia (Calvin) — VIOOH China CEO (ex-The Trade Desk China GM, AdMaster CEO; MMA China co-chair); Chen Libiao — MobTech chair (ex-Youzu co-founder); Wang Zhe — Tezign co-founder/CTO (WEF Young Global Leader); Wang Zhentong — Ai Design (and peers listed in CN gallery). Full bios & headshots in CN images — attach on ingest.

— END —
